events.title: On My Own: Nathania Ong with the Singapore Symphony
events.summary: West End singer Nathania Ong, joined by Preston Lim and Vanessa Kee and backed by the SSO, sings musical theatre, Broadway and Disney favourites, including songs from Frozen, Wicked and Les Misérables.
events.notes: Described as an evening concert; exact times and age guidance are not stated.
